brch: Danish industry codes, DB07 and DB25

Source: R/brch-package.R
brch-package.Rd

Statistics Denmark's industry classification (Dansk Branchekode) changed from DB07 to DB25, and register data carries both, in several formats. brch formats the codes, labels them, tells the two classifications apart, and converts between them with Statistics Denmark's keys. The keys and labels are bundled, so nothing goes online. See vignette("brch").

Details

Where to start

  • inspect_db(): which classification a code belongs to, with both labels.

  • convert_db07_to_db25() and convert_db25_to_db07(): strict or simplified conversion.

  • db_label(): the label of a code, for an explicit version.

  • format_db07(): dotted or compact codes from mixed input.

Why a package of its own

These functions started in the daos package. They moved here, unchanged, because they share bundled data from Statistics Denmark that the general utilities in daos do not need. brch depends only on tibble, and daos does not depend on it, or it on daos. The data is rebuilt with data-raw/db07_db25.R in the source repository.
